correctness.rationale: Scale density e^((1−2ℓ)V) and speed e^(−V) yield exact E_xτ0=∫_0^|x|H(y)e^(−2ℓV(y))dy, H=e^V∫_y^∞e^(−V), with supremum the full integral. Under V′~ηx^(η−1), V″/V′²→0, l’Hôpital gives H~1/(ηx^(η−1)). Regular-variation scaling u=2ℓx^η yields for η<2 gamma coefficient Γ(2/η−1)/η² times (2ℓ)^(1−2/η); critical η=2 logarithmic (1/4)log(1/ℓ); η>2 finite M0 and difference coefficient Γ(2/η)/[η(η−2)] times (2ℓ)^(1−2/η). Strict decreasing/convex follows integral differentiation. Infinite scale endpoints for ℓ≤1/2 give nonexplosion, uniformly bounded hitting time implies Doeblin minorization via 0 and positive compact heat kernels; when ℓ=0 and η≤2, nonuniform fixed-time return from x→∞ prevents uniform TV ergodicity. Independent exact Gaussian η=2 hypergeometric identity checks at ℓ=.01,.1,.3,.5. Numerics support the constants and normalization but not uniformity for all V.
